280-2085-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
280-2085-2645-3430.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3263-5686-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-5686-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-5686-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

222-527-4068-4247.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4068-4247.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
222-527-4068-4247.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

475-549-3197-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-549-3197-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

240-5147-5929.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Leyline of Transformation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-5147-5929.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

757-1432-5904.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

3991-4605-5686-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
3991-4605-5686-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

628-3723-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4268-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-4268-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1995-4050-7026.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight legendary enchantments.
1995-4050-7026.description:
Activate Hei Bai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each legendary enchantment you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar eight times by sacrificing eight Spirits, adding {2}{W}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Hei Bai by paying {2}{W}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

933-5902-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
933-5902-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1902-1978-5517.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1902-1978-5517.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat

1669-5531-6621-6763.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
1669-5531-6621-6763.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.

224-1359-1671-1683.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
224-1359-1671-1683.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Penance by putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Simic Growth Chamber on top of your library.
Galadriel triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from the top of your library onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

1913-2073-4659--90.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact with mana value 1 or less.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
When the Necron Warriors enter the battlefield, Salvaging Station triggers twice, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1603-1912-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Evil Twin has a power of at least 2.
1603-1912-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Evil Twin and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Evil Twin from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Evil Twin to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Evil Twin enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Evil Twin by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

369-772-4050.notablePrerequisites: Shade's Form attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-772-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Iridescent Drake, adding one mana of any color.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Repeat.

601-2907-3080.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You control at least five lands.
601-2907-3080.description:
Activate Mutavault's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Mutavault's second ability by paying {1}, causing it to become a 2/2 creature that is still a land until end of turn.
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}, exchanging the text boxes of Mutavault and Scute Swarm.
Play a land.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Mutavault's Scute Swarm ability, creating a copy of Mutavault with its original text.
Step 5 repeats in a mandatory loop unless interrupted, drawing the game.

1376-1909-2900-3314.notablePrerequisites:
Chulane and Priest of Titania do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Elves.
You control a basic Forest.
1376-1909-2900-3314.description:
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Quiron Ranger by returning a Forest to your hand from the battlefield, untapping Priest of Titania.
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning Quiron Ranger to your hand, untapping Chulane.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Wirewood Symbiote to your hand.
Cast Quiron Ranger by paying {G}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put a Forest from your hand onto the battlefield.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2265-2313-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least three +1/+1 counters.
2265-2313-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling token, putting three +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Repeat.
